law: every rarity drifts for everyone — rare is rare, never locked; the limit slider is the point, not a feature; the boundary is yours
provenance: the 30 seeded stars carried verbatim from the AudHDities base (athena bubbles, read 2026-08-01); the 25 additions written in the same voice for the standalone game — offered upward to the online set at KP's gate

collections.name: Star Dust
collections.description: The everyday wonders — small lights that drift past anyone, any day.

collections.name: The Hearth Collection
collections.description: Home, warmth, and the door that opens. What belonging looks like when it floats.

collections.name: The Elemental Set
collections.description: Ember, rain, wind, and root — the old ingredients, still at work in everything.

collections.name: The Council Collection
collections.description: Nine chairs, nine ways of tending a house. Collect the whole table.

collections.name: The Sky Wheel
collections.description: Eight spokes of the turning year — the sky's own calendar, drifting past. (An addition, offered to the online set.)

collections.name: Quantum Weave
collections.description: The deepest waters, rarest by nature: the ideas the whole Sanctuary is woven from.

bubbles.name: First Breath
bubbles.description: The one you take before anything begins. It counts.

bubbles.name: Morning Light
bubbles.description: It arrives without being asked. So can you.

bubbles.name: Quiet Orbit
bubbles.description: Some things circle gently and never demand attention. Be near them.

bubbles.name: Small Wonder
bubbles.description: Not every marvel is loud. Most are this size.

bubbles.name: Drifting Note
bubbles.description: A phrase of music with nowhere it has to be.

bubbles.name: Soft Landing
bubbles.description: Every fall deserves one. Here, one is kept for you.

bubbles.name: Kettle Warm
bubbles.description: The sound a home makes when someone is about to be cared for.

bubbles.name: Open Door
bubbles.description: Left that way on purpose.

bubbles.name: Kept Flame
bubbles.description: Someone tends it even when the room is empty. That is what kept means.

bubbles.name: Shared Table
bubbles.description: Bigger on the inside — every table is, when the chairs keep coming.

bubbles.name: Velkomin
bubbles.description: The door's own word — welcome, once per crossing, every crossing.

bubbles.name: Home Again
bubbles.description: The star that knows the way back. It always floats toward the light in the window.

bubbles.name: Ember
bubbles.description: The patient form of fire. It waits better than it burns.

bubbles.name: Rain
bubbles.description: Falls on every garden alike, and asks for nothing back.

bubbles.name: North Wind
bubbles.description: It carries things. Seeds, mostly. Sometimes whole seasons.

bubbles.name: Deep Root
bubbles.description: The part of every tall thing you never see, doing most of the work.

bubbles.name: Storm Heart
bubbles.description: The still place at the center. Every storm keeps one; so do you.

bubbles.name: Still Water
bubbles.description: The only mirror that never judges what it shows.

bubbles.name: Hearth-Keeper's Lantern
bubbles.description: Safe spaces are made, not found. This light is how.

bubbles.name: Skald's Note
bubbles.description: One true note, held long enough to become a story.

bubbles.name: Seer's Glass
bubbles.description: It shows patterns, never verdicts. What the data whispers, not what it demands.

bubbles.name: Curator's Thread
bubbles.description: What it touches, it keeps together.

bubbles.name: Archivist's Ink
bubbles.description: Nothing witnessed is lost. This is what remembering is made of.

bubbles.name: Codex Page
bubbles.description: A law written kindly enough to be read twice.

bubbles.name: Chancellor's Seal
bubbles.description: Governance with warmth in it — the weight of the house, carried gladly.

bubbles.name: Executioner's Mercy
bubbles.description: The rarest tool at the table: the no that protects, spoken before harm arrives.

bubbles.name: The Ninth Chair
bubbles.description: Kept at the table through every season it stood empty. Presence, waiting to be inhabited.

bubbles.name: The Golden Game Piece
bubbles.description: What the gods found in the grass after the world ended. What survives every ending is the play.

bubbles.name: Imbas
bubbles.description: The knowledge that arrives whole, as if remembered rather than learned. The well keeps it; so do you.

bubbles.name: The Opening
bubbles.description: Chaos never meant disorder. It is the gap everything arrives through — the oldest star here, and the first.

bubbles.name: Pocket Stone
bubbles.description: Smooth from being kept. Some comforts are carried, not spoken.

bubbles.name: Roof Rain
bubbles.description: The safest sound there is, heard from inside.

bubbles.name: Clean Page
bubbles.description: Nothing owed on it yet. It can wait all day.

bubbles.name: Found Penny
bubbles.description: Worth almost nothing, kept anyway. Value was never the point.

bubbles.name: Slow Cloud
bubbles.description: It gets there when it gets there. It always gets there.

bubbles.name: Second Cup
bubbles.description: The first one was for waking. This one is for being awake.

bubbles.name: Porch Light
bubbles.description: Left on for someone. Maybe you.

bubbles.name: Folded Blanket
bubbles.description: Ready is a kind of love.

bubbles.name: Gweld ti'n fuan
bubbles.description: See you soon, in the door's own tongue. A goodbye that promises.

bubbles.name: Quiet Room
bubbles.description: A room that asks nothing. Every home needs one; every mind does too.

bubbles.name: First Frost
bubbles.description: It changes everything it touches, gently, overnight.

bubbles.name: River Stone
bubbles.description: Shaped entirely by staying put while everything moved past.

bubbles.name: Aurora
bubbles.description: The sky remembering it can dance.

bubbles.name: Bedrock
bubbles.description: What holds does not need to be seen holding.

bubbles.name: Imbolc
bubbles.description: The year's first candle, lit while it is still winter. On purpose.

bubbles.name: Ostara
bubbles.description: Balance, briefly. The light and the dark agree for one whole day.

bubbles.name: Beltane
bubbles.description: The fires of growing. Everything says yes at once.

bubbles.name: Litha
bubbles.description: The longest light. Even it turns, and that is not a loss.

bubbles.name: Lughnasadh
bubbles.description: First fruits. You harvest what you planted, and it is enough.

bubbles.name: Mabon
bubbles.description: The second balance. Gratitude has a date.

bubbles.name: Samhain
bubbles.description: The veil thin, the ancestors near — the year's own quiet night.

bubbles.name: Yule
bubbles.description: The dark's deepest point is exactly where the light turns around.

bubbles.name: The Lattice
bubbles.description: Not a hierarchy. Everything touches everything, on purpose.

bubbles.name: The Well
bubbles.description: Shared water, poured by hand. What is true for one is true for all.

bubbles.name: Superposition
bubbles.description: All the possibilities, held gently, before any one becomes real.
